verdict: Ads are running and calls are coming in — but lead capture is broken.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, Google Ads ran continuously at $1,687.76 in spend and recorded 16 conversions, and your Google Business Profile drove 41 calls and 110 total actions from local searchers. Despite that real activity, zero leads are showing up in your CRM — the intake system is not capturing or mapping those contacts correctly, and that is being repaired now. Separately, Google Business Profile engagement dropped sharply in the last 7 days, including three consecutive days of zero actions, which we are monitoring closely as it moves into the slower late-summer period. Several items are on track to go live by August 31st — including a review boost campaign, the Homer Glen branch page, and a financing page — which will position the business ahead of the heating season ramp in October.
